metadata.title: A Half-Space Theorem for the Allen--Cahn Equation in All Dimensions
metadata.abstract: We prove that, in every dimension, a bounded, non-constant entire solution of the Allen--Cahn equation whose zero set is contained in a half-space is a one-dimensional heteroclinic solution.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 全维 Allen–Cahn 半空间刚性
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明在任意维数，有界非恒定 Allen–Cahn 全空间解若其零集包含在一个半空间，则必为一维异宿解。
analysis.breakthrough: 在所有维数把零集半空间约束提升为一维解刚性。
analysis.limitations: 要求有界、非恒定且定义于整个空间；不涵盖一般区域解或无界解。
analysis.priorityReason: 相变方程零集几何的全维强刚性。

analysisBasis.abstract: We prove that, in every dimension, a bounded, non-constant entire solution of the Allen--Cahn equation whose zero set is contained in a half-space is a one-dimensional heteroclinic solution.
